items.prompt: Differentiate y = 3x^2 - 5x + 2 and state the gradient of the curve at x = 2.

items.answer: dy/dx = 3x^2 - 3 = 0 at x = -1 and x = 1. At x = -1 the gradient changes positive to negative, a maximum (y = 2). At x = 1 it changes negative to positive, a minimum (y = -2).
